{{CharInfobox| |color={{MD Red color}} |corecolor={{MD Red color light}} |bordercolor={{MD Red color dark}} |name=Hobbes |jname=ジェイムズ |tmname=James |text=white |image=Hobbes.png |caption=Hobbes |size=250px |hometown=[[Hau'oli City]] |region=[[Alola]] |trainer=no |game=no |gender=Male |colors=yes |eyes=Black |hair=Gray |anime=yes |epnum=SM008 |epname=Lillie's Egg-xhilarating Challenge! |enva=[[Ben Phillips]] |java=[[Shinya Fukumatsu]] }} '''Hobbes''' (Japanese: '''ジェイムズ''' ''James'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is a butler to {{an|Lillie}} and her family at their mansion in [[Hau'oli City]]. He first appeared in ''[[SM008|Lillie's Egg-xhilarating Challenge!]]''. ==History== ===''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]''=== Hobbes debuted in ''[[SM008|Lillie's Egg-xhilarating Challenge!]]'', where he was shown welcoming {{an|Lillie}} at her mansion. He later had a {{pkmn|battle}} with {{Ash}}, using his {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Oricorio|Pom-Pom Style}} {{p|Oricorio}} to defeat [[Ash's Rowlet]]. He also helped to fight off a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Salandit}} that had entered Lillie's room. In ''[[SM024|Alolan Open House!]]'', Hobbes visited the [[Pokémon School]] as part of the Visiting Day. In ''[[SM027|A Glaring Rivalry!]]'', Hobbes and Lillie arrived at where {{an|Gladion}} was. He asked him to spend some time at the mansion but Gladion left. He later explained to Ash that in the past, he was cleaning at the Mansion when Gladion came to him having found an injured {{p|Eevee}} and was asked to help it. Hobbes said he took the Eevee to [[Nurse Joy]]. In ''[[SM030|The Ol' Raise and Switch!]]'', Hobbes had a battle with Lillie to help her get over her fear of touching {{AP|Pikachu}}. [[File:Lillie and Hobbes.png|thumb|left|250px|Hobbes and Lillie]] Hobbes appeared during a flashback in ''[[SM047|A Masked Warning!]]'' and physically in ''[[SM048|Night of a Thousand Poses!]]'', ''[[SM050|Faba's Revenge!]]'', and ''[[SM051|Family Determination!]]''. In ''[[SM055|The Professors' New Adventure!]]'', he attended the wedding of {{an|Professor Kukui}} and {{an|Professor Burnet}}. In ''[[SM057|The Dex Can't Help It!]]'', Hobbes helped protect Lillie from {{Rotom}} when it took on the form of a {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Rotom|Mow Rotom}}. He then reappeared in a fantasy in ''[[SM068|Real Life...Inquire Within!]]''. Hobbes made a brief appearance in [[SM078]] in the [[Poké Problem]] segment, where he was watching Lillie practice her [[Poké Ball]] throwing. In ''[[SM081|A Young Royal Flame Ignites!]]'', Hobbes was watching the [[Battle Royal]] along with Lillie. Hobbes briefly appeared during a flashback in ''[[SM087|Filling the Light with Darkness!]]'', where Lillie revealed he suddenly fell asleep due to the effects of a {{an|Necrozma}}, which happened while he was seeing her off to school. In ''[[SM093|Lillier and the Staff!]]'', Hobbes watched Lillie perform in the school play and recorded it on camera. In ''[[SM096|Don't Ignore the Small Stufful!]]'', Hobbes arrived at Professor Kukui's house to pick up Ash. In ''[[SM110|Keeping Your Eyes on the Ball!]]'', Hobbes was watching Kahili play a round of PokéGolf on TV. Hobbes briefly reappeared in ''[[SM114|Beauty is Only Crystal Deep!]]''. In ''[[SM116|The Secret Princess!]]'', Hobbes opened up a secret room inside Lillie's estate that led to [[Mohn]]'s old room. Hobbes briefly reappeared in ''[[SM123|A Fiery Training Camp Trick!]]''. In ''[[SM124|Living on the Cutting Edge!]]'', Hobbes was preparing to cut the bushes at Lillie's mansion into different shapes, when a {{DL|Ultra Beasts (anime)|Kartana}} unexpectedly appeared and cut the bushes for him. Hobbes reappeared in ''[[SM127|Chasing Memories, Creating Dreams!]]''. In ''[[SM146|Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!]]'', Hobbes saw Gladion, Lusamine, and Lillie off as they set sail on a cruise ship on a journey to find Mohn. ===''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''=== In ''[[JN112|Helping the Hometown Hero!]]'', Hobbes greeted Lusamine and her family on their return to Alola, and was reunited with Mohn. The next day, Hobbes watched a [[Battle Royal]] match between Gladion, Ash, Professor Kukui, and {{an|Kiawe}}. ==Character== Hobbes is a loyal butler, happily serving Lillie and her family as well as her friends who visit. Lillie has stated he is the best battler among the staff, which is evident in ''[[SM008|Lillie's Egg-xhilarating Challenge!]]'' and ''[[SM030|The Ol' Raise and Switch!]]'', when he battled Ash and Lillie, respectively. He is supportive of Lillie over her fears of touching Pokémon, as evident in ''[[SM008|Lillie's Egg-xhilarating Challenge!]]'', when he asked {{AP|Pikachu}} to remain outside before apologizing when Lillie said it was okay. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} This listing is of Hobbes's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Hobbes |pkmn=Oricorio |type1=Electric |type2=Flying |img=Hobbes Oricorio.png |epnum=SM008 |epname=Lillie's Egg-xhilarating Challenge! |vajp= |vaen=Erica Schroeder |desc=Pom-Pom {{p|Oricorio}} is Hobbes's only known Pokémon. It was used in ''[[SM008|Lillie's Egg-xhilarating Challenge!]]'', where it battled [[Ash's Rowlet]] and won. It was later used to fight off a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Salandit}} who was causing trouble for {{an|Lillie}}. Oricorio was later used in a battle against [[Ash's Pikachu]], which was under Lillie's command in ''[[SM030|The Ol' Raise and Switch!]]''. During the battle, Lillie was able to conquer her fear of touching Pikachu and win. In ''[[SM057|The Dex Can't Help It!]]'', Hobbes sent Oricorio out to protect Lillie from {{Rotom}}. Oricorio's known moves are {{m|Revelation Dance}}, {{m|Mirror Move}}, {{m|Teeter Dance}}, and {{m|Double Slap}}.
